svg.title: Static batching, continuous batching, and continuous batching in vLLM
svg.desc: Four requests over eight steps. With static batching, requests A, B and C form one batch that runs until A, the longest, ends at step 6. B and C finish early and their slots are padded, and request D waits until step 7. With continuous batching the batch is rebuilt every step, but a step runs either prefill or decode. D starts its prefill at step 3 in a step of its own, and A, B and C wait for one step. In vLLM, prefill and decode tokens share a step: step 3 runs the tokens of A, B, C and D as one flat input.

g.text: A BATCH RUNS UNTIL ITS LONGEST REQUEST ENDS · EMPTY SLOTS ARE PADDED
THE BATCH IS REBUILT EVERY STEP · A STEP RUNS PREFILL OR DECODE, NOT BOTH
PREFILL AND DECODE TOKENS SHARE ONE STEP · NO SLOTS, NO PADDING
Waiting in the queue or paused
